cases.utterance: what is the total transaction volume in USD?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_usd) AS total_transaction_volume FROM transactions

cases.utterance: break down the total transaction volume by transaction type
cases.expected_sql: SELECT txn_type, SUM(amount_usd) AS total_volume FROM transactions GROUP BY txn_type ORDER BY total_volume DESC

cases.utterance: what is the transaction volume per channel?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT channel, SUM(amount_usd) AS transaction_volume FROM transactions GROUP BY channel ORDER BY transaction_volume DESC

cases.utterance: how many accounts fall into each risk tier?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT risk_tier, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM accounts GROUP BY risk_tier ORDER BY account_count DESC

cases.utterance: what is the total USD exposure to sanctioned counterparties?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd) AS total_usd_exposure FROM transactions t JOIN counterparties c ON t.counterparty_id = c.cp_id WHERE c.is_sanctioned = TRUE

cases.utterance: what is the average transaction amount for each account type?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT a.account_type, AVG(t.amount_usd) AS avg_transaction_amount FROM accounts a JOIN transactions t ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.account_type ORDER BY avg_transaction_amount DESC
